I will farm this sorghum plot much like last season, but I will put a small amount of fertilizer because the plot is mine and it is easier to concentrate a little input on 0.21 hectare. I will also carry manure to it, because that is what I can manage with my family and I have seen it hold the crop better when the rain is not steady. I will keep my local sorghum seed, since here I trust the seed that has handled our conditions before. I will not irrigate, and I will do the work mostly with family labor.
